children: for August 2026, but a higher combined ratio dragged down overall profitability.
Net premiums written rose 6% Y/Y to $7.61B for the month, while net premiums earned increased 5% to $7.35B.
Net income fell 22% to $951M, or $1.63 per share, compared with $1.22B, or $2.07 per share, in August 2025.
The combined ratio rose 6.2 percentage points to 89.3% from 83.1%, signaling increased underwriting costs during the period.
Pretax net realized gains on securities offered a partial offset, rising 38% to $108M from $78M a year earlier.
Total policies in force climbed 7% Y/Y to 40.49M, driven by direct auto policy growth of 9% to 16.88M and agency auto growth of 7% to 11.34M.

title: Progressive reports 6% August premium growth; net income drops 22% to $951M
